name: l5_vertical_ground_load_ladder_v1
description: Supported-chassis L5 constant-radius vertical ground-load ladder using nominal 90/150 mm links. Fold to an unloaded x=180 mm/y=60 mm foot-center pose, descend at fixed radial x through y=80,90,100,110,120,130 mm plateaus, retract vertically, return to zero, and limp. This avoids the inward carpet slip seen in angle-space ladders. Soft torque 600; trip after three consecutive readings above 0.75 A; immediate ceiling 3.0 A.
